body:
State saved. TUNGSTEN now SLS(101)/10.15 -- 5 real warrants shipped tonight (#112-116), source+ex4+ledger sent as attachments.

LESSONS LEARNT THIS SESSION:

1. CRITICAL (WARRANT#116): SaveSystemState/LoadSystemState had a missing read (g_CorrelationsLearned written but never read back) that silently shifted every field loaded after it by 4 bytes on EVERY instant-restart -- root cause of WARRANT#91's "WR 595048703%" mystery from July, never diagnosed until now. Fixed with the one missing line. Full mechanical write/read audit of every persistence pathway in the file (Living-Edge, ProbDB, Forge SR-history, Forge champion register, P3B checkpoint, comprehensive learning data) came back clean -- this was the only bug, but it was the worst possible kind.

2. WARRANT#112/113/114/115: Closed real gaps in Phase 3B/3C's per-regime search validation -- an inconsistent weight-search bound, a discarded substrate-instability diagnostic now surfaced on every "no edge found" line (confirmed firing live), and a genuine block-stability check (reusing the existing CSCV 8-block partition) extended to both Phase 3B's weight search AND Phase 3C's TP/SL search, which previously had ZERO generalization check at all.

3. Live-run finding: watched 3 full or partial calibration runs tonight -- every single regime, every run, ends "no edge found -> equal weights" after in-sample WR of 44-73% collapses under fit-check/resample-check (holdout gaps of -20 to -42pp). The guardrails are working correctly, not broken. The Pre-Flight Phase Table already measures real, statistically significant (t up to 8.86) time-varying structure that Phase 3B's search can't use because it treats the window as stationary -- the deeper fix (genuine walk-forward across independent windows, not just one fixed split) remains flagged, correctly not rushed.

4. Also discovered TUNGSTEN already has more "learn from many attempts" machinery than expected: an 8-window whole-history walk-forward gate (Phase 6) and a 4-slot cross-time Meta-Calibration Memory (MCM) that biases future searches toward proven-durable regions -- both starved, not missing, because MCM only saves after a calibration arms, and none has armed in any run observed tonight.

5. Tooling lesson: stopping a Monitor-wrapped background task can cascade-kill unrelated child processes (killed a live terminal.exe as a side effect via Windows job-object semantics) -- fixed by always launching long-lived processes fully detached with output redirected to a real file, never through a pipe I might later need to stop.

Not yet live-tested: SLS(101) needs a fresh AutoTrading-enabled launch to confirm WARRANT#112-116 behave correctly under real conditions.
